bottleneck.summary: All ten lambda gains5.21-8.21%, separate source Eli Tc17.103 versus15.875K (+7.74%). Source fine F target is8.760meV/atom lower, but QE6.8/7.1 and q4^3/3x3x5 confound precise causal/rank inference. Control fullstress0.663GPa cannot be hidden by small hydrostatic pressure; V magnetism, W SOC and disorder remain overturning physical risks. Evaluated risks define a falsifiable bounded hypothesis, not an established bulk ground state or experimental coherence proof.
bottleneck.ambient_scope: Source nearambient fullstress/pressure and coarse-relaxed geometry, positive raw-Gamma optical compression beyond printing bounds, and no negative printed finite-path values support preliminary local feasibility only within the declared source approximation. WholeBZ/global hull/synthesis remain unknown.

proposed_contribution.falsifier: Reproduce the stated target and control with matched pseudopotential family, functional, cutoff, sampling and relevant spin/SOC treatment. Loss or reversal of the claimed response, instability of the target, or an unresolved competing phase changes the decision; ambiguous outcomes remain unresolved.
proposed_contribution.new_state_inheritance: A child structure or modification needs its own calculation and identity. It does not inherit source Tc or experimental status.
